additional_info.subject: RE: 0370508 - ID0370508-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R3 312719454/07] Cable Check phase does’nt pass multiple times on DC1 and DC2 CRM:00641000607
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs on AWS CloudWatch and found some anomalies regarding the contactor Q21-22, which is used for charging via the DC1 outlet. During the cable check, the contactor's feedback goes into an abnormal state. According to the standard for cable checks, both side contactors (charger and EV) should close properly for the cable check to be performed successfully.
Please refer to the attached log file for reference.
2024-07-23, 11:38:55
2024-07-23T11:38:55.803196+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(on FBK Timeout), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: 1
2024-07-23, 11:42:03
2024-07-23, 11:42:03 2024-07-23T11:42:03.568045+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(on FBK Timeout), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: 1
2024-07-23T12:54:58
2024-07-23T12:54:58.531188+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK while on), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_U
2024-07-23, 12:58:58
2024-07-23T12:58:58.421594+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [SCO] OGC[0]: DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK while on), CHRGOPRMODE: 6, CTRL_DC_UNIT: 1
We recommend planning for a site intervention to check the QA21-22 contactors. We suspect there might be an issue with the feedback contactor and wires which has taken for status purposes.
Please refer to the marked images below for reference to trace out the issue. Additionally, please carry spare contactors in case a replacement is needed.
If you need any assistance, please feel free to ask.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
